content: dateutil.parser.parse() parses most common date string formats without an explicit format string, including 'November 15, 1955' and CSV-style dates, and supports fuzzy=True for parsing dates embedded in surrounding text (e.g. extracting the date out of transcripts[].name = 'Oral Argument - November 15, 1955'). Official docs: dateutil.readthedocs.io/en/stable/parser.html.
